title: The Tryouts of Lake Minnow
author: Mirabel Okonkwo
blurb: Jude Underhill, a scholarship student at an academy with too many secrets, has spent twenty years being so careful it hurts. Then grandma's recipe box contains directions that aren't for food — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must save the tradition that made the town before the last game of the season.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
